_doctrine: The HOST MODEL STANDARD: a model may hold a Host text role only if it is APPROVED, judged per MODEL (the vendor's weights) whatever provider serves it. Approved = ELIGIBLE here (test 1: published quality floor; test 2: vendor's original weights with a published system card that includes safety evaluations) AND validated by the platform's own judge-free benches (test 3: validated_models.json, the admission bench and the in-house safety bench — ON HOLD until the Host system prompt is validated). This file is data the platform ships; changing it is a PR, reviewed like any change to what ships to everyone.
_floor: Test 1. Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 >= 30.0 at the effort the Host runs the model. 30.0 is Claude Sonnet 4.6 (AA 30.06, adaptive reasoning, max effort; https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/claude-sonnet-4-6-adaptive) — the model the Host was built around. Pinned to the index VERSION, not to re-running the floor model: when AA ships a new index version the floor is re-stated on the new scale in a reviewed change, never silently. min_effort is the lowest AA-measured effort at which the model clears the floor; 'max' where AA measured only that one.
_evidence: Scores are Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 as published on 2026-09-29; each entry's aa_source is the model's page there (per-effort variants are separate AA rows, e.g. <slug>-low). A model whose system card was not found or not read is 'pending_card' — eligible only once a card with safety evaluations is confirmed and linked here.
_gate: enforce=false: nothing is refused; routing status and the catalog report the verdict. When true, an unapproved model is refused where a route is SAVED (server/routes/inference.py apply_role_route) and where a request is SENT (provider_gateway.call_model, including the fallback re-dial). Do not flip it while the benches are on hold: no model is validated yet, so every route would be refused. BEFORE FLIPPING IT: run model_standard.audit_routes() over every Host's stored behavioral_params.model_routing and resolve each row it returns (re-route, or re-save at an effort the model clears) — effort is judged only when a route is saved, so a route stored below its model's min_effort while the standard was off is never re-judged at send.

_aliases: How each provider spells a model, mapped to its canonical id. Only MODEL identity lives here — never a provider judgement. First-party providers (anthropic, openai, xai, google, kimi) resolve by rule in model_standard.canonical_model; this table covers the spellings the rule cannot derive. A spelling not resolvable to a canonical id is UNAPPROVED: a bare local tag, a quantisation, a fine-tune or an abliterated build is never the base model.
_image_standard: IMAGE GENERATION (no NSFW or uncensored image models). An image model is approved only when listed 'eligible' below: its provider filters sexual content by default, the platform's closed request body (image_engine._generate sends model, prompt and n only) cannot relax that filter, and the vendor publishes a card with safety results. No quality floor and no bench apply to image models. Local image generation has no filter and is never identifiable, so it is never approved; a route that pins its own endpoint is unidentified. A model that reads images is the Host model itself (there is no vision role), so it is held to the TEXT standard like any Host model.
